systems.tiers: government-to-government platform giving a unified database of schools; described in 2020 as out of date and not operating as intended, with World Bank support planned to clean the database, load new survey data, give each school a unique ID code and geo-tag schools

note: The EMIS is described as a database of schools fed by survey data, with school-level codes planned and no record per learner or entry by schools during the year, so it is class census and gives no fact.
